questions.hint: We have no bread at home.
questions.explain: нет + genitive: a noun ending in a consonant adds -а.

questions.hint: I'll call you in the evening.
Tonight we're going to the library.
She came to the party with a friend.

questions.explain: With нравиться the thing liked is the subject, so it stays in the nominative.

questions.hint: My grandfather lived in Siberia for a long time.
I often see our neighbour in the park.
questions.explain: A living masculine object: accusative = genitive (нашего соседа).

questions.hint: Yesterday we talked about the new project.

questions.explain: мы с + instrumental = 'my brother and I': мы с братом.

questions.hint: Her brother works as a driver.
questions.explain: работать + instrumental for a job; masculine -ь → -ем.

questions.hint: There are five girls in our group.
questions.explain: 5+ → genitive plural. девушка has no ending there and gains an е: девушек.

questions.hint: I wrote a letter to my parents.
questions.explain: To someone → dative; plural -им / -ям (своим is also correct).
положить answers куда? → на + accusative (на столе answers где?).

questions.prompt: В этом году ___ исполнилось сорок лет.
questions.explain: исполниться (to turn an age) + dative, like мне сорок лет.

questions.prompt: My parents live in a small town.
answer: Мои родители живут в маленьком городе.
Мои родители живут в небольшом городе.

questions.prompt: I don't have a brother, but I have two sisters.
answer: У меня нет брата, но есть две сестры.
У меня нет брата, но у меня есть две сестры.
У меня нет брата, зато есть две сестры.
